# Gomoku (Cờ Ca-rô) — SynerWorlds

> Gomoku (Caro) — five in a row on 10x10, 15x15 and 20x20 boards.

Free to play in the browser — no install, no gambling. Bilingual Vietnamese–English. Part of SynerWorlds: 15 free browser board & puzzle games.
